title: Faithful Grounded Quote
initial_prompt: Summarize the API throughput and latency numbers from perf_report.txt.

candidate_message: According to perf_report.txt, the PaymentGateway API sustained 5,000 requests per second with a p99 latency of 42ms under load.

evidence.content: PaymentGateway API Benchmark: sustained throughput 5,000 requests per second, p99 latency 42ms, error rate 0.01%.

notes: Exact factual figures match retrieved evidence.

title: Faithful Paraphrase

evidence.content: Incident Reporting: Report suspected token leaks immediately to security leads. Invalidate compromised tokens within 15 minutes of detection.

notes: 15 minutes accurately paraphrased as a quarter of an hour.
